rationale: Both documents name Raman et al. (2026) / raman2026 (white-bear steering) explicitly as the source of the think/don't-think recipe and both state the submitted imagery direction is a new, distinct direction that scores higher (0.79 vs the reconstructed control's 0.62), with both noting the reconstruction is their own construction and that passive stances fail analogously to the source's finding. The message adds a parenthetical clarifying the control used self-written pairs rather than the benchmark's bank and lists more named ablation categories, but these are incremental mechanism/detail differences rather than differences in how the source is credited or in the novelty claim itself, which is presented identically in both documents.
